dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures exhibit irregular circular and semi-circular perimeters with high-contrast gradient transitions. The mid-lateral 'O' shape has a near-complete, jagged outer perimeter, while the anterior-dorsal 'C' shapes show open-ended, multi-nodal geometries with soft-edged luminance shifts from light interiors to dark exterior margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentration of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is low, predominantly localized in a sparse linear arrangement along the lower ventral margin and near the posterior flipper insertion point.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. An additional geometric relationship is formed by a cluster of four smaller annuli in the mid-posterior region creating an irregular quadrilateral.
